name: Amanyara
positioning: Aman resort of pavilions and villas on the northwest tip of Providenciales, with its own beach access and a dedicated host and chef for each villa
best_for: Families or groups wanting a private villa with its own pool, host and chef
Travelers who want to step from a villa straight onto the beach

facts.text: Amanyara is on the quiet northwest tip of the island, about 25 minutes from Providenciales.
The resort borders Northwest Point National Park, which is good for birdwatching and exploring underwater caves.
The name Amanyara combines Aman, meaning peace in Sanskrit, and Yara, meaning place in the language of the Arawak people who once lived on Turks and Caicos.
The resort's tranquil structures channel Aman's Asian roots and are heavy on timbers and bamboo.
The resort has one- and two-bedroom pavilions and three- to six-bedroom villas.
Each villa has its own pool, golf cart parking and outdoor area.
Beach Path Tranquillity Villas reach the beach within a three-minute walk along a dedicated footpath.
Dining centres on The Restaurant with ocean-view terraces, The Bar and the seasonal Beach Club.
The resort has four clay Har-tru tennis courts.
The spa has four treatment rooms, a relaxation pavilion, an outdoor yoga sala and a pool.

highlights.text: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host and Chef who stay on site for the duration of every stay.
Beach Sala Villas sit on the sand, with direct beach access via a private beach sala extending from the terrace.
Amanyara opened in 2006 as the first Aman property in the Caribbean.
The Six-Bedroom Amanyara Villa has a private gym and a steam room in the primary guest pavilion.
The resort runs a kids program called Nature Discovery, with sailing and mountain biking for older kids and sailing and kitesurfing lessons for younger kids.

considerations.text: The resort lists a 25-minute drive transfer from Providenciales International Airport (PLS).
The cost of food is not included in a villa stay, whether dining in the resort restaurants or in the villa.
Villas other than the Beach Sala and Beach Path villas are about seven minutes by golf cart from the resort's public areas.
